_doc: Challenge mode (design/challenge.md). Each challenge plays stage `base` (its waves, scaled for that stage) with its own rules: duration (s), hp_mul (extra on monster hp), rate_mul per monster (multiplies that monster's spawn rates), drop (monsters whose waves are removed), add (extra waves, same format as waves/*.json), every (a burst of `burst` x `monster` every `every` s from `from` to the end), win_on_boss false = survive to the end even when a boss dies. Unlocked when the slot has won stage `unlock`; the mode opens with the first one. A win gives pills_first Tẩy Tủy Đan the first time, pills after, and the base stage's gold; it is not stage progress.
